description: One call that composes route_chat + get_receipt + verify_receipt: routes a chat completion through the same policy, budget, and metering pipeline, then fetches the minted audit receipt and verifies it against the chain. Returns the completion (or the route failure — blocked and failed attempts are receipted too, and their receipts are proved the same way), the charge lines, the proof block, and an explicit not_proven list naming what the proof does not cover.

max_tokens.description: Optional cap on the completion's output tokens.

messages.description: OpenAI-shaped messages: [{role, content}] with role system|user|assistant|tool.

model.description: Optional pin: "provider:model" (e.g. "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile"), "custom:<endpoint_id>:<model>", or a bare catalog model id.

task_profile.description: Optional routing profile: reasoning (deepest models), tool-use, or bulk (cheapest/fastest). Defaults to your standing terms.

name: route_and_prove
title: Route a call and prove its receipt
